Proficient in Go, Python, and Node.js with deep experience architecting microservices, optimizing database performance, and implementing robust APIs. Demonstrated track record mentoring junior developers and shipping features to 10M+ users. Expert in containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure). Passionate about writing clean, testable code and building systems that scale.
